p1.title: Food Distribution Drive — Jawahar Nagar
p1.description: Our volunteers distributed hot meals to 120+ children and families in Jawahar Nagar today. Your support makes this possible. Every smile makes it worth it! 🙏

p2.title: Weekend Tree Plantation — 200 Saplings Planted!
p2.description: Join us every Sunday morning! Today 8 volunteers planted 200 native saplings near the riverbank. Be the change you want to see. 🌱

p6.title: Blood Donation Camp — 142 Units Collected
p6.description: Heartfelt thanks to every donor. 142 units of blood collected today will save countless lives across hospitals in our region. ❤️🩸

p13.title: Blood Donation Drive — Corporate Partnership 🩸
p13.description: Partnered with 12 corporate offices for a city-wide blood drive. 580 units collected — enough to save 1,700+ lives. Thank you, Mumbai!

p14.title: Mangrove Restoration — 1,000 Saplings Planted 🌱
p14.description: Coastal protection starts with mangroves. 50 volunteers, 1,000 saplings, 1 beautiful coastline restored. Join our next Sunday plantation drive.
